title: Charles Hall flown by the Tall Whites to Area 52 and 53 after his knee injury

there was the next morning when they came down to get me and take me up to their base at up at Area 54, 53 to see if I needed a surgery on my knee.
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by Hall, who names Areas 54/53, describes a cargo craft and adds that US generals were present.

as_told.title: Flown in a tall white cargo craft to the Area 54/53 base for a knee check, with US generals present
as_told.place_text: Range Four to the tall white scout craft hangar, Areas 53/54, Nevada

plain: In the 1960s, at the Nevada Test Site near Area 51, a secret military base, a man named Charles Hall says he hurt his knee and was flown by the Tall Whites, tall pale beings he says he lived alongside, up to their base to see whether he needed surgery. Hall tells it at first hand, naming the base as Area 53 or 54, describing the craft as a cargo ship and saying US generals were there, and he writes about these years in his book Millennial Hospitality. Michels retells it more briefly, as Hall being flown from Area 51 to Area 52 and then Area 53.
